# Eazy Peeze Apps

> Eazy Peeze Apps makes simple privacy-first apps: Pdf Buddy (100% local Windows PDF editor, 2 free actions/day, then INR 299/year or INR 999 lifetime) and Kharch Log (Android expense tracker on Google Sheets, INR 149 lifetime). Site: easypeeze.com - expenses product also at kharchlog.com.

Last updated: 2026-11-23
Canonical site: https://easypeeze.com/
Sitemap: https://easypeeze.com/sitemap.xml
Full corpus: https://easypeeze.com/llms-full.txt
Contact: support@easypeeze.com

## Key facts

- Brand: Eazy Peeze Apps
- Pdf Buddy: Windows 10/11 desktop PDF editor, local-first (no upload required for edits)
- Pdf Buddy free: 2 actions/day after Google sign-in; paid: INR 299/year or INR 999 lifetime
- Kharch Log: Android UPI/SMS expense tracker -> your Google Sheet; INR 149 lifetime
- Support: support@easypeeze.com
- Kharch site: https://kharchlog.com/

## Features

- [Compress Pdf](https://easypeeze.com/features/compress-pdf/): Compress PDFs for WhatsApp / portal size limits.
- [Convert Pdf](https://easypeeze.com/features/convert-pdf/): Convert images and Office files to PDF.
- [Edit Pdf](https://easypeeze.com/features/edit-pdf/): Edit PDF text and pages offline on Windows.
- [Merge Pdf](https://easypeeze.com/features/merge-pdf/): Merge multiple PDFs into one file locally.
- [Ocr Pdf](https://easypeeze.com/features/ocr-pdf/): OCR scanned PDFs into searchable text.
- [Sign Pdf](https://easypeeze.com/features/sign-pdf/): Draw or place signatures without Adobe.
- [Split Pdf](https://easypeeze.com/features/split-pdf/): Split PDF pages into separate files.
- [Unlock Pdf](https://easypeeze.com/features/unlock-pdf/): Unlock password-protected PDFs you own.
